tasks.label: Generate IG
tasks.command: java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -jar input-cache/publisher.jar -ig . && notify-send -u normal -i info 'IG generation complete.'
tasks.detail: Generate IG and notify when complete

windows.command: java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -jar input-cache/publisher.jar -ig . && powershell -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show('IG generation complete.', 'Build Complete', 'OK', 'Information')"

osx.command: java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -jar input-cache/publisher.jar -ig . && osascript -e 'display notification "IG generation complete." with title "Build Complete"'
